Shipper / Receiver – Forklift Operator	
Kestrel Bay Distribution | Richmond, BC

About the role:
We’re a fictional food-service distributor and we’re looking for a dependable Shipper/Receiver to join our day crew.

Duties:
1) Load and unload trucks using a sit-down or reach forklift
2) Check incoming orders against packing slips and report shortages
3) Pick, pack and wrap outgoing orders accurately
4) Keep the dock and racking areas clean and safe

Requirements
•	Valid forklift certificate (sit-down and reach truck)
◦	At least 1 year of shipping/receiving experience
▪	Able to lift up to 25 kg repeatedly
–	Basic computer skills for our WMS (scanner + tablet)
*	Steel-toed boots required

Nice to have:
	• WHMIS training
	• “Can-do” attitude – we’ll train the right person!

Hours: Mon–Fri, 7:00 a.m. – 3:30 p.m.  (40 hrs/week)
Wage: $22.50/hr + $1.00/hr after probation
Benefits: Health & dental after 3 months, RRSP matching

To apply, send your résumé to jobs@example.com – no phone calls please.
